title: Localized power relation with coefficient residues in the flat local source
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring, q a prime ideal, L=Lambda_q, m its maximal ideal, N>0, n>=N, and S=L/m^n [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime, def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Let u in q and z_j (j in Fin s) in Lambda satisfy m^N contained in the ideal of their images in L. Let D be a commutative local ring, S local, and g:D to S a flat local ring map [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. Suppose b_j in D map to the residues of z_j and the residue of u belongs to g(D). There are w_j in L such that the image of u to the power 2N equals sum w_j times the image of z_j, and the residues of all w_j belong to g(D).

proof.text: Set U to be the image of u and choose a in D with residue g(a)=U mod m^n. Flat locality gives faithful flatness. Contract membership of g(a)^N in the ideal generated by the residues of z_j to get a^N=sum d_j b_j in D.

Choose lifts c_j in L of g(d_j). The error U^N-sum c_j z_j lies in m^n=m^(n-N)m^N, hence in m^(n-N) times the ideal of the z_j. The definition of ideal multiplication and finite spanning express the error as sum cprime_j z_j with cprime_j in m^(n-N). Set w_j=U^N(c_j+cprime_j). Multiplication and distribution give the exact 2N-th power relation. The term U^N cprime_j lies in m^n and its residue is zero, so the residue of w_j is g(a^N d_j). This includes n=N and empty families.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_popescu_localized_coefficient_relation
    {Λ : Type v} [CommRing Λ] (q : PrimeSpectrum Λ)
    (N n : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N) (hn : N ≤ n)
    (u : Λ) (hu : u ∈ q.asIdeal) (s : ℕ) (z : Fin s → Λ)
    (hpower : IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ N ≤
      (Ideal.span (Set.range z)).map (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal)))
    (D : Type w) [CommRing D] [IsLocalRing D]
    (g : D →+* Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
    [IsLocalRing (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal ⧸
      IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)]
    [IsLocalHom g] (hgflat : g.Flat) (b : Fin s → D)
    (hb : ∀ j, g (b j) = Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (z j)))
    (hinc : Ideal.Quotient.mk
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n)
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) u) ∈ Set.range g) :
    ∃ w : Fin s → Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal,
      (algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) u) ^ (2 * N) =
        ∑ j : Fin s, w j * algebraMap Λ (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) (z j) ∧
      ∀ j, Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q.asIdeal) ^ n) (w j) ∈
        Set.range g
